question: Which of the following books is written by Mulk Raj Anand?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Untouchable.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Mulk Raj Anand** is the author of the book **"Untouchable".**
 
• The book is about the** life of a young Indian man **who is considered an untouchable, and the discrimination he faces in society.
 
• Mulk Raj Anand was a prominent Indian writer
